Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
If Lucian, the Perfect Night Moves bleeds me can I play AI? I think I can.

[obf]  Bleed your predator or prey at +3 stealth. If more than 1 pool is bled with this action, ignore the excess.
[OBF]  As above, but bleed at +6 stealth.

Messages.Author: Wedge
Messages.Body:
Master: out-of-turn.
Only usable when a minion is attempting to bleed you and the bleed amount is 4 or more. Burn the acting minion. (The action is not successful.)

I don't see how that answers the question. Bled is past tense implying a successful action. Until the action is successful the bleed is for four at six stealth, I think.

Messages.Author: KevinM
Messages.Body:
Lucian, the Perfect, is attempting to bleed you for 4 at +6 stealth, using Night Moves.

AI: "Only usable when a minion is attempting to bleed you and the bleed amount is 4 or more."

The resolution effects of Night Moves are irrelevant to AI, because AI doesn't check at that time. That's why AI is such a good card.
